limitations: These are AI-authored fictional cases, not human gold, production traffic or externally verified product facts.
Construction after the v3 prompt freeze and distinct products establish a new cohort, not statistical independence or absence from model pretraining.

The rubric and failure taxonomy were available to the author; some categories deliberately overlap development patterns. New conditional, temporal, comparative and embedded-instruction combinations exercise transfer.
The public source packets and references become development material once outcomes are inspected. Reusing them after modifying the grader cannot establish fresh qualification.
All answers fit one server unit; this cohort does not qualify long-answer multi-unit behavior, retrieval, generation, policy improvement or activation.
